flags.avg_clause_length: The supplied extractor averages sentence token lengths here; it does not count clauses.
flags.sent_length_variability: Coefficient of variation: its denominator contains mean sentence length.
flags.content_word_richness: Shares content-word counts with entropy and hapax measurements.
flags.hapax_legomena: Singleton content-word share; constrained by content-word richness.
flags.verb_lemma_diversity: Can contain large masses at one; inspect the actual discrete bands.
flags.comma_ratio: Character denominator; total punctuation_ratio instead uses tokens.
flags.period_ratio: Character denominator; total punctuation_ratio instead uses tokens.
